jobs.occupation: Specialist in General Surgery - Nordic Island
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Have you been considering a career change but have not yet found the right opportunity?
Are you looking for a position where you can work across a broad range of surgery, take responsibility, and at the same time enjoy a healthy work-life balance? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery to join a smaller acute care hospital located on a Nordic island in a unique setting. Here, you will have the opportunity to work broadly within surgery and become an important part of a close-knit clinical team.
About the position
The surgical department offers a broad scope of practice and is not divided into narrow subspecialty sections. This means you will work with a varied patient population and have the opportunity to use a wide range of your surgical skills.
The work includes gastrointestinal surgery, gallbladder and hernia surgery, colorectal surgery, proctology, endoscopy and acute surgery. Both open and laparoscopic surgery are performed.
Endoscopy is a natural part of the surgical practice and includes both gastroscopy and colonoscopy.
Working at a smaller acute care hospital means that the working day can vary considerably. You should therefore enjoy a broad surgical role and feel confident assessing and managing a range of surgical conditions.
Close collaboration and a supportive team
As a surgeon, you will become an important part of a smaller team where colleagues work closely together and support one another. Collegial support and guidance are available when needed.
We are not looking for someone who is expected to know everything. What matters is that you have broad surgical competence, sound clinical judgement, and the confidence to recognise when you may need support or wish to further develop your skills in a particular area.
The smaller hospital setting also gives you the opportunity to contribute your experience and play an active role in the continued development of the department.
Work-life balance
The position is located in a unique Nordic island environment, surrounded by the sea, archipelago and nature. It offers an attractive alternative for those seeking a different lifestyle from what is often associated with working at a large regional or university hospital.
For those who value both a professionally rewarding career and time for family, leisure and recovery, the location offers an attractive combination.
Qualifications
We are looking for a specialist who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has broad surgical competence and experience
Has experience in gastrointestinal and acute surgery
Has experience in endoscopy, particularly gastroscopy
Is comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
Has good collaboration skills and a patient-centred approach
Is flexible and appreciates the variety that comes with working at a smaller acute care hospital
Has good English language skills
Has a strong motivation to learn Swedish. Language training is provided.

Experience in additional areas of surgery is considered an advantage.
Who are you?
You are a Specialist in General Surgery who appreciates the breadth of the specialty and enjoys working in a smaller clinical environment where collaboration, flexibility and responsibility are a natural part of everyday work.
You are confident in your professional role, collaborative and open-minded. You value being part of a close-knit team where colleagues support one another and where your experience and expertise can make a meaningful contribution to both the department and its patients.
You are also motivated to continue developing professionally and are happy to share your own knowledge and experience with colleagues.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Interested?
If you are interested in this opportunity or would like to learn more, you are very welcome to contact us.
We would be happy to tell you more about the position.
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Framtidens fordon – och en vinter du sent kommer glömma!❄️
Vill du vara en del av den senaste tekniken inom bilindustrin – på riktigt? Hos Tjintokk i vackra Slagnäs, Arjeplog (Lappland), får du chansen att vara med när ett av världens största bilmärken vintertestar sina allra nyaste bilmodeller. 🚘
Här testas fordon under extrema förhållanden – på noggrant preparerade banor både på land och is. Vårt uppdrag är att leverera högsta kvalitet och service på alla plan. Och just nu söker vi dig som vill bli en viktig del av det arbetet som lokalvårdare.
💫 Rollen som lokalvårdare – mer än bara städning
Som lokalvårdare är du med och ser till att våra miljöer – från hotellrum till verkstäder – håller absolut toppklass. Ditt arbete är en förutsättning för att både våra gäster och kollegor ska trivas och kunna prestera på högsta nivå.
Vi söker dig som:

Är noggrann och tar ansvar

Trivs i ett högt arbetstempo

Har lätt för att samarbeta och ta egna initiativ

Ser vad som behöver göras – och gör det med ett leende

Har ett öga för detaljer och förståelse för vikten av sekretess

Har erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter (meriterande)

Kan kommunicera obehindrat på engelska, eftersom vi har en internationell arbetsmiljö

🌟 Vad vi erbjuder dig
Hos Tjintokk blir du en del av ett varmt och engagerat team med kollegor från hela världen. Förutom ett meningsfullt arbete i en unik miljö får du tillgång till:

Prisvärda personalboenden för dig som kommer utifrån

Luncher och middagar till mycket förmånliga priser i vår egen restaurang

Fullutrustat gym, ishockeyrink och fina skidspår

Social gemenskap med aktiviteter och härlig sammanhållning

Vi rekryterar lokalvårdare till flera avdelningar:

Hotellrum

Allmänna ytor i hotell

Allmänna ytor i verkstäder (B-körkort krävs här)

🗓️ När?
Anställningar för vintersäsongen 2026/2027 sker löpande under oktober till december.
Kom som du är – bli en del av vår vinterfamilj
Hos oss på Tjintokk blir du en del av något större. Vi ser oss som en familj under den mörkaste tiden av året – och tillsammans skapar vi en ljus och minnesvärd säsong.
Välkommen att uppleva en riktig vinter – med oss! ❄️
The Vehicles of the Future – and a Winter You'll Never Forget! ❄️
Do you want to be part of the latest technology in the automotive industry – for real? At Tjintokk in beautiful Slagnäs, Arjeplog (Lapland), you'll have the chance to participate when one of the world's largest car brands winter-tests their newest vehicle models. 🚘
Here, vehicles are tested under extreme conditions – on carefully prepared tracks both on land and ice. Our mission is to deliver top-quality service on every level. And right now, we’re looking for someone like you to become a key part of that work as a cleaning staff member.
💫 The Role of a Housekeeper – More Than Just Cleaning
As a housekeeper, you help ensure that our environments – from hotel rooms to workshops – are kept in top condition. Your work is essential for both guests and colleagues to feel comfortable and perform at their best.
We’re looking for someone who:

Is thorough and takes responsibility

Thrives in a fast-paced work environment

Works well with others and takes initiative

Sees what needs to be done – and does it with a smile

Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of confidentiality

Has experience in similar roles (a plus)

Can communicate fluently in English, as we have an international work environment

🌟 What We Offer
At Tjintokk, you’ll be part of a warm and dedicated team with colleagues from all over the world. In addition to meaningful work in a unique environment, you’ll also get access to:

Affordable staff accommodation for those coming from outside the area

Lunches and dinners at great prices in our on-site restaurant

A fully equipped gym, ice hockey rink, and scenic ski trails

A social atmosphere with activities and strong team spirit

We are recruiting cleaners for several areas:

Hotel rooms

Common areas in the hotel

Common areas in the workshops (B driving license required for this position)

🗓️ When?
Hiring for the winter season 2026/2027 takes place continuously from October to December.
Come as you are – become part of our winter family
At Tjintokk, you’ll be part of something bigger. We see ourselves as a family during the darkest time of the year – and together, we create a bright and unforgettable season.
Welcome to experience a real winter – with us! ❄️

På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av den natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.
I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt större arrangemang. Inspirationen hämtas från stadens tre kulturer den svenska, samiska och tornedalsfinska och genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Camp Ripans kök är ett av Sveriges mest klimatsmarta kök, där vi arbetar med modern teknik och hållbara arbetssätt för att minimera vår påverkan på miljön.
Nu söker vi en engagerad och driven souschef som vill bli en viktig del av vårt kök och samtidigt njuta av en storslagen fjällvärld med norrsken, midnattssol och fantastiska fritidsmöjligheter.
Som souschef har du en central roll i den dagliga driften av köket och ansvarar för att servicen flyter på med hög kvalitet, struktur och ett gott samarbete mellan kök och servering. Du leder genom att vara en förebild, stöttar och motiverar dina kollegor och bidrar till en positiv, respektfull och lösningsorienterad arbetsmiljö.
I rollen ingår även att säkerställa kvalitet, struktur och hygien i köket samt planera mise en place, lager och beställningar. Tillsammans med kökschefen arbetar du med kostnader, matsvinn och menyutveckling. Du är en viktig länk mellan kök, kökschef och servering, löser problem som uppstår under service och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamet och verksamheten.
Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för matlagning och yrket, trivs i ett högt tempo och tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du har minst sex års erfarenhet inom restaurang, gärna med tre års utbildning och tre års arbetslivserfarenhet från à la carte-restaurang. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har god kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och/eller engelska och trivs med att ta ansvar. Som person är du engagerad, prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att skapa riktigt bra mat och få ett team att fungera tillsammans.
Tjänsten är på 100 % och är en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetstiderna varierar utifrån verksamhetens behov och innebär arbete på både vardagar och helger. Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov.
Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten. Välkommen med din ansökan!
 
At Camp Ripan, you have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.
At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our restaurant, where we serve breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our culinary inspiration comes from Kiruna’s three cultures Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian which are reflected throughout our entire operation. Camp Ripan’s kitchen is one of Sweden’s most climate-conscious kitchens, where we use modern technology and sustainable practices to minimise our environmental impact.
We are now looking for an engaged and driven Sous Chef who wants to become an important part of our kitchen team while enjoying the spectacular mountain environment, with the Northern Lights, Midnight Sun and fantastic outdoor activities right on your doorstep.
As Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the kitchen and be responsible for ensuring that service runs smoothly, with high quality, structure and strong cooperation between the kitchen and other departments. You lead by example, support and motivate your colleagues, and contribute to a positive, respectful and solution-oriented working environment.
Your responsibilities will also include ensuring quality, structure and food safety in the kitchen, as well as planning mise en place, monitoring stock levels and handling orders. Together with the Head Chef, you will work with food and labour costs, food waste and menu development. You will be an important link between the kitchen, Head Chef and service, solving problems that arise during service and actively contributing to the development of both the team and the operation.
We are looking for someone with a genuine passion for cooking and the profession, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working as part of a team. You have at least six years of experience in the restaurant industry, preferably including three years of culinary education and three years of professional experience in an à la carte restaurant. You are confident in your professional role, have good communication skills in Swedish and/or English, and enjoy taking responsibility. As a person, you are committed, humble and solution-oriented, with a genuine motivation to create great food and help a team perform at its best.
This is a full-time, permanent position (100%). Working hours vary according to the needs of the business and include both weekdays and weekends. Staff accommodation is available if needed.
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once we have found the right candidate.
We look forward to receiving your application!
